The page lists no verb names, so verbs such as `filter`, `groupBy`, `sort`, `distinct`, `sum`, `lower`, `split`, `keys`, `take`, `round`, `avg` and `default` are guesses, and so are some argument shapes. Each query is my single attempt written from the page alone.
